sources.snippet: This model, derived from meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1b-Instruct, is specifically designed for question-answering tasks. It features a 32k token context length, making it suitable for processing longer inputs in its specialized domain.

sources.title: FAME/README.md at main · ClaudioSavelli/FAME · GitHub
sources.snippet: FAME (Fictional Actors for Multilingual Erasure) is the first benchmark designed to evaluate machine unlearning in multilingual large language models (LLMs). The dataset enables reproducible evaluation of both entity-level (complete identity deletion) and instance-level (selective fact removal) forgetting.
